content.title: Sixers vs. Spurs Tickets & Matchup History
content.text: Now these contests are headlined by a new era. The Sixers are led by 2023 NBA Most Valuable PlayerJoel Embiid, 2024 NBA Most Improved Player, Tyrese Maxey, and nine-time NBA All-Star, Paul George. In the 2023-24 season, the 76ers hosted the Spurs on January 22, winning 133-123 with a career and franchise history setting night from Joel Embiid. The reigning MVP put up 70 points, 18 rebounds, and 5 assists, becoming only the 8th player in NBA history to record 70 points in a game. On top of that, he recorded 24 points in the 1st quarter alone. He became the only player in NBA history to record at least 70 points, 15 rebounds, and five assists in one game. Their second matchup of the 2023-24 season was another career night for a 76er. Tyrese Maxey recorded a career-high 52 points against the Spurs in a thrilling double overtime win for the Sixers with a final score of 133-126. Through the 2024-25 season, the 76ers hosted the Spurs on December 23, winning 111-106. Maxey recorded a double-double with 32 points and 10 rebounds. The 76ers then traveled to San Antonio to face the Spurs on March 21, losing 120-128. Rookie Justin Edwards tied his career-high 25 points. The Sixers and Spurs matchup in two late season games in ‘25-26. Their first contest was on March 3 on home territory for Philadelphia where the Sixers fell 91-131. The 76ers will travel to San Antonio to face the Spurs on April 6 to finish their regular season series. Get tickets to see the Sixers play at home!
